long_biography.plain_text:
When a promised St George's Bay hotel site went to another developer, Maltese hotelier Winston V. Zahra and his partner Nazzareno Vassallo turned towards a different acquisition. On their flight home from a Radisson convention, they decided to buy the neglected Salina Bay Hotel. Zahra directed its rapid rebuilding as the Coastline, then used international franchises while keeping management within Island Hotels Group.

His influence extended beyond the company through leadership roles in Malta's tourism institutions. He served as president of the Malta Hotels and Restaurants Association, chaired the Malta Tourism Authority's marketing board and joined the University of Malta council. Malta appointed him a Member of the National Order of Merit for his contribution to tourism.
long_biography.html:
When a promised St George's Bay hotel site went to another developer, Maltese hotelier Winston V. Zahra and his partner Nazzareno Vassallo turned towards a different acquisition. On their flight home from a Radisson convention, they decided to buy the neglected Salina Bay Hotel. Zahra directed its rapid rebuilding as the Coastline, then used international franchises while keeping management within Island Hotels Group.

His influence extended beyond the company through leadership roles in Malta's tourism institutions. He served as president of the Malta Hotels and Restaurants Association, chaired the Malta Tourism Authority's marketing board and joined the University of Malta council. Malta appointed him a Member of the National Order of Merit for his contribution to tourism.
